text:
kaitlyn: Heads-up — Stillwater launch window is set for 2026-03-24 23:00 UTC. We're instituting a hard freeze from 22:30 -> 00:30 UTC for all non-critical changes. Please ACK if you have rollback ownership or exceptions.

mike: ACK. I'll own rollback for model-serving / inference routes. If canary latency > 150ms for 2 consecutive minutes, i'll pin back to v1.

anya: Oncall here — I'll run T-15 smoke, T+5 production sanity, and monitor traces. If anomaly, i'll trigger rollback.

sam: Deploybot standing by. Planned command to kickoff: `/deploy start stillwater --canary=5% --stage=eu,us --pin=v2` — will wait for manual OK from release lead.

kaitlyn: Thanks. Release notes link: https://redwood-internal/release/Stillwater-2026-03-24 (ops-runner updated). Key bullets in notes: model v2 swap, routing change for small requests, embedding cache warmup.

ops-runner: Confirmed — release notes pushed and changelog bumped. Added rollback owners and a short playbook in the docs.

mike: Quick rollback snippet i'm planning to use (keeping it simple):
```
# pin back to previous model version
redwoodctl routing set --service=model-serving --version=v1 --force
# revert split
redwoodctl rollout cancel --name=stillwater-canary
```
I'll paste the full traceable ops commands into the runbook now.

deploy-bot: FYI — Preflight checks OK (image hash match, infra quotas available). Canary slot reserve: 5% (2 GPUs). Waiting for manual /deploy confirm from @kaitlyn.

anya: Note: embeddings ingestion is exempt from cache-busting during the freeze — small batches only. Keeping an eye on mem pressure.

kaitlyn: Two operational asks before we go: 1) mike/anya confirm rollback runbook link in thread 2) sam confirm deploybot will abort on >20% error-rate during canary.

mike: Runbook link added: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/rollback-stillwater. Also added a step to open a support incident automatically if rollback happens.

sam: Deploybot config: abort-on-error=20, abort-window=120s. Manual override allowed with `--force`. I'll also mute non-critical alerts for the window.

anya: I'll set up a short alert page for p50/p95 latency and error-rate and be in the channel T-minus 10.

kaitlyn: Perfect. Final green?

mike: green :white_check_mark:

anya: green :thumbsup:

sam: green — deploybot armed

kaitlyn: OK kicking at 23:00. Keep chatter here only for critical updates. If you need to escalate, DM me and @anya then post final status here.

deploy-bot: `/deploy start stillwater --canary=5% --stage=eu,us --pin=v2` executed at 3234567930. Canary rollout initiated. Will post status updates.

deploy-bot: Canary: 5% -> health ok. Latency p95=120ms, errors 0.8%.

anya: T+5 smoke: all synthetic checks pass, small traffic sample validated. continuing to monitor.

mike: Observing expected token throughput. No mem OOMs. If anything spikes, ping me and i'll cut the rollout.

deploy-bot: Canary expanded to 30% at 3234567945. Health: p95=125ms, error=1.2%. Not exceeding abort thresholds.

kaitlyn: Copy. Everyone stand by for final sweep — we hold until 23:10 to decide full rollout. If no issues, proceed to 100%.

ops-runner: Release note pinned to docs channel and customers notified per comms plan.

anya: if error-rate crosses 3% i'll initiate rollback. current metrics look stable.

mike: +1. Rollback playbook ready.

kaitlyn: Thanks team. Logging this thread as the Stillwater launch paperwork. I'll post final status once we hit 100% or roll back.
